name: mochicode-auto
description: Keep stock-quality Sol direct and add proven Luna workers, bounded fan-out, or selective evidence gates only when their overhead is justified.

interface.longDescription: Preserves stock Sol High behavior for substantive and small sequential work, uses a real Luna Medium child only for sizable independent leaves that repay delegation overhead, permits small Sol-led fan-out only after a vertical slice freezes disjoint interfaces, and activates one evidence-bound fresh verifier or durable state only when an observable trigger applies. Model claims require session evidence or child receipts, and the deterministic controller remains an explicit unpromoted experiment.
defaultPrompt: Complete this goal using the smallest quality-proven automatic route.
Keep stock Sol behavior unless a proven worker route clearly repays its overhead.
Use a selective worker, fresh verifier, or durable state only when its observable trigger is present.
